correctness.rationale: For z=a+ib ≠0, norm N=a²+b²>0 is rational and L(z)=1/2 Σ_p v_p(N)/p. Thus odd denominator prime valuations are ≤1 and v2≤2. Conversely gcd(m,{4m/p:p|m})=1 for odd squarefree m supplies Bezout coefficients generating each permitted r from L(1+i)=1/4 and L(p)=1/p. The independent kernel radii 4/27 and 4/3125 have irrational logarithm ratio by 3-/5-adic valuations, generating a dense multiplicative subgroup of R>0, and rational unit-circle parametrization gives dense angles, so multiplication by one representative makes each fiber dense in C. No arbitrary radical outside Q(i) is used. Independent exact rational check tested 2250 nonzero Gaussian-rational tuples; it corroborates, not proves, the unrestricted claims.
